decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=/net/ws-server/srv/sensor, src=/reply-ep } — dst routes THROUGH a multi-peer (bus) link's own connection NAME with a residual below it that names no peer
decoded.note: RFC-0020 (ADR-0073 §3), amending RFC-0004 §B: valid, round-trip-safe bytes at the CODEC layer (the 3-core conformance machine stays green). At the ROUTING layer, when net/ws-server/srv is a multi-peer link and 'sensor' names no current peer, the frame MUST be rejected — a single directed kind=ERROR reply STATUS=ERROR(tr::path::invalid=0x0021) along the accumulated src — and MUST NOT be broadcast over the bus endpoint nor resolved against the local graph. A dst naming the mount exactly, or continuing through a peer name (p<slot>), is unaffected. The C++ mount_routing_test asserts the rejection.
